reviewNotes: Twenty-three late-game item, horse, weather, seasoning, freshness, fishing-audio, trader, food-buff, animal-audio, furniture, credits, renovation, quest, and combat strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established item and recipe names, gender-neutral status wording, exact placeholders and trailing spaces, concise gameplay feedback, soundtrack-title voice, punctuation, and natural Romanian interface phrasing; both found no remaining objective issue.
